ValidationRule.description: Due date must equal issue date plus the payment-terms days (CASE ladder), allowing 1 day slack and forbidding Sunday due dates for Net 30+.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Issue_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Due_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Payment_Terms__c))), OR( ABS((Due_Date__c - Issue_Date__c) - CASE(TEXT(Payment_Terms__c), 'Net 15', 15, 'Net 30', 30, 'Net 60', 60, 0)) > 1, AND(CASE(TEXT(Payment_Terms__c), 'Net 30', 1, 'Net 60', 1, 0) = 1, WEEKDAY(Due_Date__c) = 1) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Due Date does not match the Payment Terms.
